items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: When I got with Milton Larkin, we had a band that we billed with Milton supervising the situation

ctx.x: Now you said your biggest influence was Joe Thomas.

All right, we've talked about Joe Thomas, we talked about Milt Larkin. When I got with Milton Larkin, we had a band that we billed with Milton supervising the situation -- he's a good organizer, a good businessman, and

was a good leader. Cedric Haywood was with that band, and then eventually we had a battle of music at the Eldorado Ballroom, the Wyler Wylie Collegiates came down and then that band had Wild Bill Davis on his senior year, but he was just Bill Davis then.
